channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. Awaits Tehran’s Response to Peace Proposal
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: Israel kills Hezbollah commander in Beirut strike
item.description: Israel killed a Hezbollah commander in a Beirut strike. Iran-US war latest: Israel kills Hezbollah commander in Beirut strike The Telegraph.

item.title: Indian sailors recount nights of missile attacks near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Indian sailors were attacked with missiles near the Strait of Hormuz. Indian sailors recount nights of missile attacks near Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump to Host Brazil’s President Lula at White House After Months of Ups and Downs
item.description: President Trump will meet Brazil's President Lula at the White House. President Trump and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who have had a rocky relationship, will meet on Thursday for talks on security, trade and critical minerals.

item.title: US pushing Israeli de-escalation ahead of new talks: Lebanese official
item.description: The US is pushing Israel to de-escalate ahead of talks in Washington. Talks between Lebanese and Israeli delegations to be held in Washington, DC, next week, the official tells Al Jazeera.

item.title: Lebanon Latest Israeli strikes Beirut despite ‘ceasefire’
item.description: Israel carried out an airstrike on Beirut's southern suburbs, despite a US-brokered ceasefire in place since April 16. The strike marks a new escalation in tensions. Israel has carried out its first airstrike on Beirut’s southern suburbs since the April 16 US-brokered ceasefire.

item.title: Rubio visits Vatican amid escalating tensions between Trump and Pope Leo
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Rome to preserve the relationship between Washington and the Holy See amid escalating tensions between Trump and Pope Francis. Secretary of State Marco Rubio traveled to Rome in an effort to preserve a crucial relationship between Washington and the Holy See.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal as Trump pressures Tehran for agreement on deal to end war
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal for a deal to end the war as Trump pressures Tehran for an agreement. Tehran denies allegations its forces were behind a blast on a Panama-flagged ship.

item.title: Myanmar junta claims recapture of trade artery towards China
item.description: Myanmar's military claims to have recaptured a trade artery to China, crushing "terrorist insurgent groups" along the route. The route links Mandalay to Myitkyina, near China's border.

item.title: Russia's Victory Day parade with no tanks a sign Ukraine war not going to plan
item.description: Russia's Victory Day parade in Moscow will feature soldiers but no military hardware, a first in nearly two decades. The absence of tanks is seen as a sign that the Ukraine war is not going as planned.

item.title: Iran’s President Pezeshkian seeks to quash divided leadership narrative
item.description: Iran's President Pezeshkian has emphasized solidarity among top officials, countering a narrative of divided leadership. This comes as Washington pressures Iran over disputes in the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran emphasises solidarity among top officials as Washington pressures Iran during Strait of Hormuz disputes.

item.title: U.S. Awaits Iran’s Response to Latest Peace-Talks Proposal
item.description: The US is awaiting Iran's response to a latest peace-talks proposal. The development is part of ongoing diplomatic efforts to address tensions between the two nations. No details on Iran's stance have been released yet.

item.title: How CNN founder changed television news and kids’ entertainment in India
item.description: CNN founder Ted Turner's influence on Indian television and children's entertainment is being remembered. His network's entry into the Indian market helped shape the country's media landscape. How CNN founder changed television news and kids’ entertainment in India.

item.title: Iran ceasefire or fresh bombing? Inside the Trump administration’s contradictory signals
item.description: The Trump administration sent mixed signals on Iran, suggesting both a ceasefire and fresh bombing. The conflicting messages have left Iran's situation uncertain. Iran ceasefire or fresh bombing? Inside the Trump administration’s contradictory signals.

item.title: US-Israel war on Iran leaves Jordan’s Petra nearly empty of tourists
item.description: The US-Israel war on Iran has severely impacted tourism in Jordan, leaving Petra nearly empty of tourists. This has resulted in significant losses for Jordanians who rely on tourism for income.

item.title: Starmer Braces for Local Election Losses Amid New Era of UK Politics
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Labour Party faces predicted historic losses in local elections due to gains by Reform U. K. The results may signal a shift towards multiparty politics in the UK.

item.title: South Africa condemns 'fake videos' of alleged xenophobic attacks
item.description: South Africa condemned 'fake videos' of alleged xenophobic attacks as claims of xenophobia mount. Ghana called on the African Union to send a fact-finding mission. Tensions rise in the region.

item.title: Over 200 structures destroyed and a Navy HQ forced to flee
item.description: Over 200 structures were destroyed and a Navy headquarters was forced to evacuate due to a recent attack. The extent of the damage and the identity of those responsible remain unclear.

item.title: Why is the US seeking UN help to open Hormuz after undermining it?
item.description: The US has sought UN help to ensure the free flow of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. This move comes after the US undermined the Iranian nuclear deal and imposed sanctions on Tehran, which has led to increased tensions in the region.

item.title: EU Firms Generate 186 Billion Euros In India, Support 6 Million Jobs: Report
item.description: EU firms have generated 186 billion euros in revenue in India and support 6 million jobs. The EU's relationship with India goes beyond commerce, according to EU Ambassador to India Herve Delphin.
